clusters.title: Lindsey Graham, Republican Senator, Dies From Sudden Illness
clusters.summary: Lindsey Graham, a Republican senator from South Carolina and a close ally of Donald Trump, died on Saturday evening at the age of 71 due to a 'brief and sudden illness,' according to his office. His passing has prompted tributes from various political figures, including Trump, who called him a 'true American patriot.' Graham was known for his advocacy of U.S. military involvement overseas and had been a significant figure in the Senate for over two decades.

clusters.title: Book Examines 1898 Wilmington Coup by White Supremacists
clusters.summary: Lauren Collins' new book, 'They Stole a City,' explores the 1898 coup in Wilmington, North Carolina, where white supremacists violently overthrew the city's multi-racial government. This event, marked by the killing of numerous Black residents, is noted as the only successful coup in U.S. history. The book sheds light on this little-known chapter of American democracy and its implications.
